result.summary: The page is generally usable, but there is a clear data/display bug: one restaurant shows an invalid delivery price. A couple of minor carousel truncation/cropping behaviors are visible but likely intentional.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers displays “€NaN delivery”, indicating missing or invalid delivery fee data being rendered as Not-a-Number.
issues.suggestion: Validate delivery fee data before rendering; hide the fee, show a fallback such as “Delivery unavailable”, or fix the upstream pricing value so NaN never reaches the UI.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in “Fastest near you” and the rightmost category chip are partially cut off at the viewport edge.
issues.suggestion: If intentional for horizontal scrolling, add a fade/overflow indicator or peek spacing; otherwise adjust carousel padding and card widths so content is not ambiguously clipped.

issues.description: Restaurant name “Trattoria Piccol…” is truncated in the visible card area.
issues.suggestion: Use controlled ellipsis with full name available on tap, or increase card width/line allowance for long restaurant names.
